looks.description: A blonde-haired woman with a poorly sculpted, still-transforming face and a ghoulish, sheepish smile, a crooked, sideways nose, a lumpy chin and unusually thick hair, wearing a poorly sewn tracksuit and blocky snow boots.
looks.change: Scene-only: half-formed face with crooked nose, lumpy chin, poorly sewn tracksuit and snow boots.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman with a natural human face, wearing a blue tracksuit and holding a small axe.
looks.change: Scene-only: blue tracksuit and small axe.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman with a purple mohawk and a natural-looking face, like someone who has had a lot of cosmetic surgery, wearing a slick black bodysuit and poorly shaped knee-high boots.
looks.change: Scene-only: purple mohawk, black bodysuit and knee-high boots.

looks.description: A blonde-haired creature with a pale, surgically-altered-looking face, about seven feet tall with a torso three times thicker than normal and arms that reach the ground like a gorilla's, one hand turned into a curved metal shield.
looks.change: Scene-only: seven-foot gorilla-armed form with a metal shield hand.

looks.description: A flesh-colored, plow-shaped form in front of a subway car, with a pair of eyes and a mouth sitting in a little divot near the top of the scoop.
looks.change: Scene-only: flesh-colored plow shape with a face in a divot.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman wearing a red leather outfit.
looks.change: Baseline: regular human form in red leather.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman in a hulking she-hulk form, about eight feet tall and wide, carrying a riot shield on her left arm.
looks.change: Scene-only: eight-foot she-hulk form with riot shield.

looks.description: A shapeshifter formed into a half-shell shape, acting as a shield against an incoming plane.
looks.change: Scene-only: half-shell shield shape.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman in a regular human form, holding an iced tea with a little umbrella in her hand.
looks.change: Scene-only: holding an iced tea with a little umbrella.

looks.description: A shapeshifter who has formed herself into the entire back seat of a chariot, also shaping the duct-taped body of a gnome figure seated atop it as a disguise, with a fake dromedarian neck added to complete the disguise; her real eyes are hidden within the duct tape.
looks.change: Scene-only: chariot back seat with duct-taped gnome decoy and fake dromedarian neck.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman in a tank-like form, with a shield on her arm and a crossbow over her head.
looks.change: Scene-only: tank form with shield and crossbow.

looks.description: A shapeshifter who has transformed herself to cover a submarine hull, camouflaging herself against it.
looks.change: Scene-only: spread across a submarine hull as camouflage.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman in a regular human form, grinning with worry in her eyes, looking haggard and exhausted.
looks.change: Scene-only: haggard, exhausted, worried grin.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman in a large she-hulk form with a determined look on her face, wearing a backpack that lets her add mass and with a second pair of arms holding a jacket in place.
looks.change: Scene-only: large she-hulk form with backpack and extra pair of arms.

looks.description: A woman whose body has formed into a sentinel gun, with a metal arm that looks like flesh, wearing a backpack that lets her add mass.
looks.change: Scene-only: sentinel gun form with backpack and flesh-like metal arm.

looks.description: A little, almost human girl with dark hair and a bare head, with all her original parts except missing fingers and a missing nose.
looks.change: Scene-only: small girl with missing fingers and nose.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman wearing a crown on her head.
looks.change: Scene-only: wearing a crown.

looks.description: A large, blonde she-hulk with heavy rings under her eyes. Multiple stalks containing eyeballs have grown on the back of her neck.
looks.change: Scene-only: large she-hulk with eyeball stalks on neck.

looks.description: A manta-like creature with four legs instead of arms.
looks.change: Scene-only: manta-like creature with four legs.

looks.description: A small-looking blonde woman in a regular human form, with a hollow look in her eyes and one scoop-shaped hand, with an extra set of hands grown.
looks.change: Scene-only: hollow eyes and scoop-shaped hand.

looks.description: A small-looking blonde woman in a regular human form, with a crow with the skull of an infant sitting on her shoulder, blended into her.
looks.change: Scene-only: skull-faced crow on shoulder.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman transformed into a towering mantaar with giant manta hands, in the process of forming a mullet, with a second set of arms and bulging muscles so she towers over those near her.
looks.change: Scene-only: towering mantaar form with extra arms.

looks.description: A blonde-haired woman with eyes gone completely white, as if frozen.
looks.change: Scene-only: completely white eyes.

looks.description: A small woman with black hair, missing her left leg, her right leg below the knee, and an ear, with a raised cybernetic right arm.
looks.change: Scene-only: black hair, missing limbs and ear, cybernetic right arm.

card.value: Enchanted Shade Knoll Riot Force's Crowd Control Shield
